# Treehouse

> > Treehouse is an online coding bootcamp offering expert-led video courses, self-guided learning tracks, and interactive projects across web development, programming languages, and specialized tech skills.

Treehouse provides accessible coding education through structured learning paths (Tracks), hands-on projects (Code Adventures), and comprehensive course libraries. The platform serves individual learners, businesses, libraries, and military personnel with flexible, affordable tech training.

## Key Topics

- Web Development
- JavaScript
- Python
- HTML & CSS
- React
- SQL
- Learning Tracks
- Techdegree
- Code Adventures
- Cybersecurity
- Data Analysis
- College Credit
- Skill-Based Learning
- Interactive Projects
- Programming Fundamentals

## Learning Paths & Courses

- [Learn to Code Online | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com): Main homepage offering expert-led video courses in coding, programming, and design
- [Tracks: Self-Guided Learning Paths | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/tracks): 60+ expert-curated learning paths combining courses, workshops, and projects
- [Online Coding Courses – Start Learning | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/library): Browsable catalog of all courses organized by topic and difficulty level
- [Code Adventures | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/code_adventures): Interactive hands-on projects for web development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript

## Educational Programs & Partnerships

- [The College Credit Program at Treehouse](https://join.teamtreehouse.com/college-credit): College credit partnership with UPI and ACE for transfer credits at 1500+ universities
- [Coding Education Solutions for Business | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/teams): Business solution for team training in coding with enterprise learning management
- [Online Coding Classes for Library Patrons | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/libraries): Treehouse program providing coding classes to library patrons and organizations
- [Coding for Veterans, Service Members and Families | Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/military): Discounted coding and design courses for military veterans and service members

## Community & Support

- [Treehouse | Community | Linking to Sections of a Web Page](https://teamtreehouse.com/community): Community forum for student questions and peer coding help discussions

## Optional

- [Affiliates](https://join.teamtreehouse.com/affiliates): Affiliate program for educators and developers to earn rewards promoting Treehouse
- [Shared Links](https://teamtreehouse.com/links): Community-shared developer tools, APIs, and resources for web development
